sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A SERIES OF SHORTWAVE IMPULSES AMPLIFYING SEWD ACROSS S CNTRL CANADA BETWEEN NOW AND THU WILL CARVE A LARGER-SCALE...PROGRESSIVE TROUGH OVER THE UPR GRT LKS/UPR MS VLY BY THE END OF THE PERIOD...DOWNSTREAM FROM REX BLOCK OVER THE INTERMOUNTAIN WEST. AHEAD OF THE AMPLIFYING TROUGH...WEAK DISTURBANCES WILL ACCELERATE ENEWD IN BELT OF SEASONABLY STRONG WSW FLOW EXTENDING FROM WI/MI TO NRN NEW ENGLAND AND THE ST LAWRENCE VLY. AT THE SFC...SHALLOW WARM FRONT NOW OVER NRN/ERN ME WILL MIX RAPIDLY NEWD LATER THIS MORNING...WHILE MAIN FRONTAL ZONE ASSOCIATED WITH ERN FLANK OF DEVELOPING UPR TROUGH REMAINS MORE OR LESS STNRY THROUGH THE DAY FROM NRN MI TO NRN NE BRUNSWICK. BY EVE AND CONTINUING THROUGH EARLY THU...HOWEVER...AMPLIFYING UPR TROUGH WILL INDUCE COLD FRONTOGENESIS OVER THE UPR MS VLY/UPR GRT LKS. THE LEAD SFC FRONT SHOULD ACCELERATE ESEWD...LIKELY REACHING THE LWR GRT LKS/IND/IL BY THE END OF THE PERIOD. COMBINATION OF FAST/DEEP WSW FLOW...STRONG SFC HEATING/MOISTURE INFLUX...AND WEAK INHIBITION /RELATIVE TO YESTERDAY/ SHOULD SUPPORT SEVERAL ROUNDS OF STRONG TO SVR STORMS OVER PARTS OF UPSTATE NY AND NRN NEW ENGLAND. MORE WDLY SCTD ACTIVITY MAY EXTEND W INTO PARTS OF THE MIDWEST/

sections.title: LWR GRT LKS/UPSTATE NY TO NRN NEW ENGLAND TODAY THROUGH TNGT
sections.text: WEAK HEIGHT FALLS ASSOCIATED WITH MINOR DISTURBANCES IN FAST WSW FLOW ALOFT...COUPLED WITH DIFFERENTIAL HEATING/TERRAIN CIRCULATIONS S OF AFOREMENTIONED STNRY FRONT...SHOULD SUPPORT SCTD STORM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS SRN ONT/SRN QUE...UPSTATE NY...AND NRN NEW ENGLAND BY EARLY AFTN. RESIDUAL EML ACROSS THE REGION WILL RESULT IN WEAKENED CIN /RELATIVE TO TUE/...BUT MAINTAIN AMPLE MID-LVL LAPSE RATES FOR ROBUST UPDRAFTS. WITH SFC DEWPOINTS LIKELY TO AVERAGE IN THE UPR 60S TO AROUND 70 F /PER LATEST OBSERVATIONS AND LIKELIHOOD FOR DOWNWARD MIXING/...EXPECT MLCAPE TO BE AOA 2500 J/KG. DEEPLY UNIDIRECTIONAL WSWLY FLOW WITH 40+ DEEP SHEAR SHOULD FOSTER DEVELOPMENT OF SUSTAINED STORMS/SUPERCELLS...ESPECIALLY FROM NRN NY INTO NRN NEW ENGLAND. THESE LIKELY WILL EVOLVE INTO SEVERAL BANDS...CLUSTERS...AND LEWPS...WITH AN ASSOCIATED RISK FOR DMGG WIND AS WELL AS HAIL. A CONDITIONAL THREAT ALSO WILL EXIST FOR A TORNADO OR TWO...ESPECIALLY IN NE VT..NRN NH...AND ME...WHERE LOW-LVL FLOW MAY REMAIN SOMEWHAT BACKED. THE SVR THREAT SHOULD BE MORE LIMITED FARTHER S OVER PARTS OF PA AND CNTRL NEW ENGLAND...WHERE SHEAR WILL BE MARKEDLY WEAKER AND PULSE/MULTICELL STORMS ARE LIKELY TO ERUPT OVER THE HIGHER TER

sections.title: UPR GRT LKS THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: LOW-TOPPED TSTMS MAY FORM/STRENGTHEN ALONG COLD FRONT NOW OVER MN AS IT CONTINUES SEWD INTO THE UPR GRT LKS LATER TODAY...SUPPORTED BY SFC HEATING AND DCVA AHEAD OF LEAD UPR IMPULSE MOVING SEWD FROM CANADA. THIS ACTIVITY MAY AFFECT UPR MI...NRN LWR MI...AND PERHAPS PARTS OF WI. WHILE THE BOUNDARY LAYER WILL NOT BE VERY MOIST IN WAKE OF LEAD COLD FRONT LOCATED FARTHER SE...STEEPENING LOW-LVL LAPSE RATES AND STRONG/DEEP WLY FLOW MAY FOSTER SOME STRONGER STORMS/SMALL CLUSTERS CAPABLE OF LOCALLY DMGG WIND AND/OR MARGINALLY SVR HAIL.

sections.title: CNTRL HIGH PLNS TO MID/LWR MO VLY THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: ANOTHER ROUND OF SCTD DIURNAL STORMS IS EXPECTED TODAY ALONG WEAK COLD/STNRY FRONT OVER THE CNTRL PLNS/MO VLY. WEAK HEIGHT RISES...SLIGHT WARMING ALOFT...AND WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR WILL CHARACTERIZE MOST OF THE FRONTAL ZONE IN THIS REGION. AMPLE HEATING/DESTABILIZATION SHOULD...HOWEVER...OCCUR TO YIELD A FEW STORMS CAPABLE OF ISOLD DOWNBURSTS. ..CORFIDI/DEAN.. 09/11/2013

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A SIGNIFICANT SHORT-WAVE TROUGH OVER CNTRL MANITOBA WILL PROGRESS SEWD CONTRIBUTING TO THE AMPLIFICATION OF A LONG-WAVE TROUGH OVER CNTRL/ERN CANADA INTO THE UPPER MS VALLEY AND GREAT LAKES. A LOWER-AMPLITUDE IMPULSE /NOW OVER THE UPPER GREAT LAKES/ WILL PRECEDE THE MANITOBA SYSTEM...EJECTING ENEWD ALONG THE ST. LAWRENCE VALLEY. IN THE LOW LEVELS...MID-MORNING SURFACE ANALYSIS SHOWED A SLOW-MOVING COLD FRONT EXTENDING FROM LOW PRESSURE OVER CNTRL QUEBEC SWWD THROUGH THE UPPER GREAT LAKES INTO THE MID MO VALLEY AND CNTRL HIGH PLAINS. THIS BOUNDARY WILL CONTINUE TO SLOWLY SETTLE SEWD WITH THE WRN SEGMENT BEING OVERTAKEN BY A STRONGER...MORE PROGRESSIVE COLD FRONT ADVANCING OUT OF THE NRN PLAINS AND UPPER MS VALLEY. ...LOWER GREAT LAKES/UPPER OH VALLEY INTO NEW ENGLAND THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT... LATEST MODEL GUIDANCE INDICATES A COMPLEX CONVECTIVE EVOLUTION TODAY WITH STORMS FORMING ALONG THE SEWD-MOVING COLD FRONT...LAKE BREEZE CIRCULATIONS...AND WITHIN THE OPEN WARM SECTOR AS BACKGROUND FORCING FOR ASCENT IS ENHANCED BY THE LEAD SHORT-WAVE TROUGH MOVING ACROSS THE GREAT LAKES. sections.text: CONVERGENCE/UPLIFT ALONG THE COLD FRONT WILL PROMOTE WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS THIS AFTERNOON WITHIN A HOT...STEEP-LAPSE-RATE BOUNDARY LAYER WHERE MLCAPE WILL APPROACH 1000-2000 J/KG. mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL LIKELY BE ISSUED BY 17Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING IS RAPIDLY AGITATING CLOUD DEBRIS FIELD OVER ERN OH/WRN PA. ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS ARE BEGINNING TO INTENSIFY ALONG BACK EDGE OF THIS CLOUDINESS NEAR CMH EWD INTO SWRN PA AND UPWARD EVOLVING THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS ARE EXPECTED TO EMERGE ACROSS THIS REGION OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. 12Z SOUNDINGS FROM ILN AND PIT EXHIBIT SIGNIFICANT INSTABILITY WITH MODEST LAPSE RATES AND ABUNDANT PW...1.75-2 INCHES. WHILE DEEP LAYER SHEAR IS NOT PARTICULARLY STRONG ACROSS THIS REGION THERE IS INCREASING CONFIDENCE THAT ROBUST UPDRAFTS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING WET MICRO BURSTS WILL EVOLVE FROM THIS ACTIVITY. WITH TIME ACTIVITY SHOULD SPREAD/DEVELOP NEWD INTO NY WHERE STRONGER DEEP LAYER FLOW MAY ALLOW FOR MORE ORGANIZED UPDRAFTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL LIKELY BE ISSUED SOON ACROSS MUCH OF NEW ENGLAND INTO THE HUDSON VALLEY OF NY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CU FIELD IS DEEPENING OVER HIGHER TERRAIN OF UPSTATE NY WHERE SFC TEMPERATURES HAVE WARMED INTO THE UPPER 80S. CU FIELD WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO EXPAND AS BOUNDARY LAYER HEATS OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. TEMPERATURES DOWNSTREAM ACROSS VT/NH ARE QUITE WARM WITH READINGS NOW APPROACHING 90F...ROUGHLY CONVECTIVE TEMPERATURE BASED ON EARLY MORNING SOUNDINGS. RAPID WARMING/DESTABILIZATION IS EXPECTED ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF NRN NEW ENGLAND PRIOR TO TSTM DEVELOPMENT. OVER THE LAST HOUR OR SO MID LEVEL CONVECTION HAS GRADUALLY DEEPENED ACROSS SERN QB ALONG THE ST. LAWRENCE VALLEY AND LIGHTNING IS NOW OBSERVED WITH DEEPER UPDRAFTS ROUGHLY 70MI NORTH OF THE VT BORDER. THIS ACTIVITY IS MOVING QUICKLY EAST IN EXCESS OF 40KT AND SHOULD SPREAD INTO EXTREME NRN ME OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. GRADUAL INTENSIFICATION IS POSSIBLE WITH THIS CONVECTION BUT NEW SFC-BASED TSTMS SHOULD EVOLVE WITHIN AFOREMENTIONED CU FIELD AND ACROSS HIGHER TERRAIN OF VT/NH/ME AS AIRMASS CONTINUES TO DESTABILIZE. DAMAGING WINDS ARE THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREATS WITH ORGANIZED CLUSTERS/LINE SEGMENTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS THE ENTIRE WATCH AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: NUMEROUS THUNDERSTORMS HAVE DEVELOPED ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE UPPER OH VALLEY INTO SRN NY. MANY STORMS HAVE TAKEN ON CHARACTERISTICS THAT APPEAR FAVORABLE FOR WET MICROBURSTS AND LARGE HAIL...PER LATEST WDSSII ALGORITHM. THIS ACTIVITY HAS EVOLVED WITHIN A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS THAT REMAINS SUPPORTIVE OF ROBUST MULTICELL UPDRAFTS AND A GRADUAL NEWD EXPANSION IS EXPECTED ACROSS NY TOWARD THE HUDSON VALLEY OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. UNTIL SIGNIFICANT CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING HAS OCCURRED SEVERE STORMS ARE EXPECTED ACROSS WW520. ..DARROW.. 09/11/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE LATER THIS AFTERNOON WITH ISOLATED SEVERE WIND AND HAIL POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG HEATING CONTINUES ACROSS MUCH OF LOWER MI AND INTO NRN IND AND OH WITH CU FIELDS INCREASING. GPS PWAT SENSORS SHOW A CONTINUED INCREASE IN MOISTURE WITHIN A SW-NE ORIENTED PLUME FROM NRN IL INTO LOWER MI...WITH VALUES IN EXCESS OF 1.60". MEANWHILE...A MODIFIED 18Z DETROIT SOUNDING SHOWS AMPLE INSTABILITY FOR VIGOROUS UPDRAFTS...WITH A MODESTLY LONG HODOGRAPH MARGINALLY FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS. RECENTLY...SURFACE WINDS HAVE BACKED TO SLY ACROSS SERN LOWER MI...ENHANCING A CONFLUENCE ZONE FROM SWRN LOWER MI NEWD TOWARD LAKE HURON AND THIS SHOULD BE THE MAIN AREA FOR INITIATION. STORMS COULD THEN MATURE AND MOVE TOWARD THE DETROIT METRO AREA LATER TODAY WITH SEVERE WEATHER POSSIBLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS OVER NRN VT/NH AND ME WILL POSE AN ISOLATED SEVERE WEATHER THREAT THIS EVENING. DAMAGING WINDS AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE WITH STORMS FORMING ALONG SURGING COLD POOL LOCATED OVER ERN NY. THIS ACTIVITY WILL ENTER WRN MA AND SRN VT/NH DURING THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 2245Z...SURFACE HEAT AXIS...WHERE TEMPERATURES RESIDE IN THE 80S TO LOW 90S...WAS POSITIONED FROM ERN PA NEWD INTO CNTRL ME. THOUGH TEMPERATURES ARE GRADUALLY COOLING ALONG THIS AXIS...A VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WITH SURFACE DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW 70S CONTINUES TO SUPPORT MLCAPE VALUES IN EXCESS OF 2500 J/KG. ELONGATED COLD POOL IS SURGING ENEWD AT 30 KT ALONG THE NRN EDGE OF THE INSTABILITY AXIS. GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF DEEP-LAYER WSWLY SHEAR NEAR 30 KT...SEMI-ORGANIZED DAMAGING WIND THREAT WILL BE POSSIBLE ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THE COLD POOL AS IT MOVES FROM ERN NY INTO SRN VT/NH AND WRN MA DURING THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS. FARTHER NE...WEAKENING 0-3 KM LAPSE RATES FROM NRN VT/NH INTO ME SUGGESTS THE BOUNDARY LAYER IS STABILIZING. THUS...THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT IS EXPECTED TO BE MORE ISOLATED WITH ONGOING STORM CLUSTERS AND ANY ADDITIONAL REDEVELOPMENT ALONG A COLD FRONT MOVING SSEWD INTO THE AREA. ..GARNER.. 09/11/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS CONTINUES FOR WW 521...PRIMARILY FROM CNTRL MA INTO NH AND SRN ME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: BOWING QLCS WAS LOCATED FROM CNTRL NH SSWWD INTO CNTRL MA AT 0130Z...AND IS MOVING ENEWD IN EXCESS OF 30 KT. TEMPERATURES AHEAD OF THIS ACTIVITY WERE IN THE 70S TO LOW 80S AND DEWPOINTS WERE IN THE LOW 70S. THE VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER COMBINED WITH STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES /REF 00Z GYX RAOB/ CONTINUES TO YIELD MLCAPE VALUES FROM 2000-3000 J/KG. DEEP-LAYER WSWLY SHEAR NEAR 30 KT IS AIDING IN COLD POOL ELONGATION...AND GIVEN THE UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT LOCATED DOWNSTREAM ACROSS SRN ME...WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT A BOWING LINE OF CONVECTION ALL THE WAY TO THE COAST THAT WILL POSE A RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS. OTHER STORMS OCCURRING OVER NRN NY/VT ARE EMBEDDED IN A LESS UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT...BUT EFFECTIVE SHEAR FROM 30-50 KT MAY OFFSET THE MARGINAL THERMODYNAMICS AND SUPPORT AN ISOLATED SEVERE WEATHER THREAT THROUGH PART OF THE NIGHT. ..GARNER.. 09/12/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
